summary.en: Kogoro and Conan discovered a corpse on the street while taking a stroll. Seemingly, the deceased have been hit in the head with a metal pipe, and remained a dying message that looks like "1-1-2". The estimated time of death is around 9PM last night, Conan visited the deceased's apartment. Location: Beika street Victim: Akira Komoda Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Tosuke Utagawa According to the apartment manager, no one seem to hold grudge with the victim Komoda. Owing to the fact that Komoda doesn't have a job and claimed yesterday afternoon that he will pay off all of his unpaid apartment rent tomorrow, Kogoro deduces that he must be blackmailing people for a living, and Komoda might be anti-killed by his blackmailed target. The manager added that Komoda noticed the photo of Tosuke Utagawa on the magazine, who is the CEO of Utagawa Corporation. And declared that Utagawa would be the perfect target for him to blackmail, due to his wealth. The police talked to the CEO, Utagawa. He seemed rather arrogant, and he doesn't have an alibi when the crime was carried out. Up until now, he looks like the person who would kill Komoda for a plausible reason. Tomoe Izumi, the lady that they encountered in the crime scene, said that yesterday morning Komoda approached her to consult about Juichi Innami, who was a her former resident. Innami had been gone for ten days and had only came back the other night. However, he claimed that he was moving away. Izumi showed a video with the appearance of Innami which shocked everyone, Innami looks exactly identical with the CEO Utagawa. Are they the same person? After a long time of reasoning, another possibility emerged. Innami may be a substitute of Utagawa for fabricating certain alibi, in the premise of their exact same appearances. Kogoro said that it's possible that Komoda blackmailed Utagawa by taking advantage over this matter, and Innami might be killed by Utagawa after the alibi was fabricated. Later, they found out that there was a reward ceremony that was held within Utagawa's company on the evening of 9th. This leads to the assumption that Innami might've substituted Utagawa to attend the ceremony. However, by doing fingerprint analysis, the fingerprints on the winner award tend to matched with Utagawa's. This means that it was the real CEO who attended the ceremony, the investigation went into a stalemate once again. While investigating, Conan and Kogoro deduced Komoda's dying message: 11 refers to the number's pronunciation (Jū-ichi/十一) referring to Juichi Innami, and the 2 means in reality the kanji 乙 (Oto), referring to Otohime Park (乙姫公園), the park where Komoda usually hung out. In conclusion, the dying message means that Juichi Innami is related to the park and that probably something happened there that was witnessed by Komoda, and that's why he was killed. Now that they have those clues, they immediately start to investigate the park, and after digging a hole, they find the dead body of Juichi Innami. Location: Otohime Park Victim: Juichi Innami Cause of death: Strangulation Suspects: Tosuke Utagawa Conan thinks there's more behind this case, and finally discovers a shocking truth.
